blocks.text: SCHEDULE: 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinals MANILA, Philippines–Barangay Ginebra drew first blood over San Miguel Beer in their 2026 PBA Governors’ Cup quarterfinal series with a 104-95 victory on Tuesday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. Import Jordan Murphy tallied 29 points, 11 rebounds and four blocks, but the Gin Kings also got a big lift from Isaac Go, who made key plays in the second half to create separation from the Beermen. Go scored six of his 14 points in the third quarter in perhaps his best performance since a lengthy absence due to a knee injury. The win was Ginebra’s fourth […]...
